items.quote: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son
items.claim: Lamech lived 182 years and fathered a son

items.quote: And he called his name Noah
This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed
items.claim: Noah will provide comfort regarding work and toil because of the cursed ground
items.mechanism: because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed
